statements.text: Unless decorative, the glyph has role img named by the label attribute. With no label the registry name itself (e.g. "system/search") is announced, so set label or decorative.

attributes.description: Marks the icon decorative when it should be hidden from assistive technology.
attributes.name: decorative

attributes.description: Registry name for the icon, using source-prefixed ids such as system/search.
attributes.name: icon

attributes.description: Optional accessible label when the icon is not decorative.
attributes.name: label

summary: Renders an SVG glyph from the icon registry by name; use inside buttons, badges and labels.

usage.text: The icon attribute is a registry name such as system/close (default system/search). An unregistered name renders an X-shaped fallback. The registry is read when icon is set, so register first.
violet-icon registers no icons. Add one with registerVioletIcon({ name, svg, sourceId, originalFile }); the generated registerSystem*Icon() helpers are in dist/icon/generated/index.js, not the root.
It is a 1em square that inherits currentColor; size it with font-size or the --violet-icon-size custom property.
